svg.text: VariLab | marginal modes are not a joint MAP decoder
Two supplied spins: h=(1/4,63/256), J=-2. No evidence. The joint MAP is unique.
Unnormalized log-potential score E(z), higher is better; one shared vertical scale
Exact gap: 449/128 = 3.5078125. Both gates are asserted: MAP passes, marginal-mode score fails.
Ties need compatible backtracking, even when all local max-marginal choices look optimal.
Symmetric J=-2, h=(0,0): 2 joint optima. Both spins individually allow -1 and +1.
Naive first local choices (-1,-1): score -2. Stored conditional traceback (-1,+1): score +2.
128 isolated zero-field spins: exactly 2^128 optimal assignments, counted without enumeration.
Exact rational scores/counts for compiled binary floats; ordinary marginal probabilities use float sum-product.
Constructed decision-question counterexamples, not a method ranking. Acyclic supplied graphs only, up to 128 spins.
